body.statement: Under the conditions of Yan--Wainwright Proposition~1, their estimated entrywise variance obeys equation~\(6.10\): with probability at least \(1-O((N+T)^{-10})\), its absolute error relative to the population variance is at most \(C_\gamma\{\delta/\sqrt{\log(N+T)}+\sqrt{(N_1+T)r/(N_1T)}\}\).

attestation.note: Checked directly against the arXiv v2 source at equation (6.10).
